dataset.title: Thermomechanical pulp fiber-property regression dataset
dataset.summary: Forty-six thermomechanical-pulp samples with 14 fiber-description predictors and eight responses comprising Canadian Standard Freeness and handsheet properties.

predictors.name: Shives
predictors.description: Shives-category measurement from the Pulp Expert analyzer; source units retained.

predictors.name: Fines B
predictors.description: High-aspect-ratio Fines B particle measurement; source units retained.

predictors.name: L (arith)
predictors.description: Arithmetic mean of the measured particle contour length L.

predictors.name: L (lw)
predictors.description: Length-weighted mean of the measured particle contour length L.

predictors.name: L (llw)
predictors.description: Length-length-weighted mean of the measured particle contour length L.

predictors.name: W (arith)
predictors.description: Arithmetic mean of the measured particle width W.

predictors.name: W (lw)
predictors.description: Length-weighted mean of the measured particle width W.

predictors.name: W (llw)
predictors.description: Length-length-weighted mean of the measured particle width W.

predictors.name: C (arith)
predictors.description: Arithmetic mean of the measured particle curl C.

predictors.name: C (lw)
predictors.description: Length-weighted mean of the measured particle curl C.

predictors.name: C (llw)
predictors.description: Length-length-weighted mean of the measured particle curl C.

predictors.name: F (arith)
predictors.description: Arithmetic mean of the measured fibrillation descriptor F.

predictors.name: F (lw)
predictors.description: Length-weighted mean of the measured fibrillation descriptor F.

predictors.name: F (llw)
predictors.description: Length-length-weighted mean of the measured fibrillation descriptor F.

sample_alignment.description: Row i in X.csv and row i in Y.csv refer to the same pulp sample. The source supplementary table stores all variables on one row, so selecting and splitting columns preserves alignment.

provenance.citation: Lindström, S. B., Ferritsius, R., Carlson, J. E., Persson, J., and Nilsson, F. (2025). Predicting handsheet properties and enhancing refiner control using fiber analyzer data and latent variable modeling. Computers & Chemical Engineering, 199, 109143.

source.supplementary_material: MMC S1, spreadsheet containing refiner controls, specific refining energy, fiber properties, and pulp and handsheet properties.

preparation.description: Select the named fiber-property variables Shives through F (llw) as predictors and the named variables CSF through s as responses from the publication supplementary table. Refiner controls, specific refining energy, and the final k variable are not part of the model matrices. Preserve all 46 rows, selected numeric values, column order, and row order. No values are imputed, centered, scaled, rounded, or otherwise transformed.
